q: The Kolkata Metro Rail Corporation Limited (KMRCL) is implementing which corridor of the Kolkata Metro?
e: KMRCL is the special purpose company executing Kolkata's East-West Metro corridor, running from Salt Lake Sector V towards Howrah across the Hooghly.

q: The Railways Act, 1989, which presently governs the working of Indian Railways, replaced which earlier enactment?
e: The Railways Act, 1989 repealed and replaced the Indian Railways Act, 1890, which had governed railway working in India for nearly a century.

q: The first steam locomotive built by the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works in 1950 was named:
e: Deshbandhu, named after Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das, was the first steam locomotive built by Chittaranjan Locomotive Works and rolled out in 1950.

q: The original design of the Integral Coach Factory (ICF) type coaches of Indian Railways was based on the lightweight coach design obtained from:
e: ICF coaches were based on the lightweight all-metal design obtained from the Swiss firm Schlieren, so the original design source was Switzerland.

q: The headquarters of the Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited (IRFC) is located at:
e: The Indian Railway Finance Corporation, the market-borrowing arm of Indian Railways, has its registered and corporate office at New Delhi.

q: The heritage steam locomotive shed of Indian Railways, which preserves and maintains vintage steam locomotives including the Fairy Queen, is located at:
e: Rewari in Haryana houses the heritage steam loco shed that preserves vintage steam locomotives, including the Fairy Queen, and keeps them in working order.

q: The Kolkata Metro Rail Corporation Limited (KMRCL), the company implementing the East-West Metro corridor of Kolkata, was incorporated in the year:
e: Kolkata Metro Rail Corporation Limited was incorporated in 2008 as the implementing agency for the East-West Metro corridor project.

q: The headquarters of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Limited (DMRC) is housed in the building at Barakhamba Road in New Delhi known as:
e: Metro Bhawan on Barakhamba Road in New Delhi is the headquarters building of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Limited.

q: In the restructured Railway Board, the functions of rolling stock and traction are headed by the:
e: After the 2020 Railway Board restructuring, rolling stock and traction matters are dealt with under the Member (Rolling Stock) in the Board.

q: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), which supplies traction equipment to Indian Railways, is a public sector undertaking under the:
e: BHEL is a Maharatna public sector undertaking under the Ministry of Heavy Industries, though it supplies traction and other equipment to the Railways.

q: The Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO) at Lucknow is headed by an officer holding the designation of:
e: RDSO, the research and standards wing of Indian Railways at Lucknow, is headed by its Director General.

q: The National Academy of Indian Railways at Vadodara is housed in the historic palace complex known as:
e: The National Academy of Indian Railways at Vadodara functions from the Pratap Vilas Palace complex, a heritage palace adapted for railway training.

q: The Diesel Locomotive Works at Varanasi, now known as the Banaras Locomotive Works, was set up in collaboration with which foreign locomotive manufacturer?

options.A: General Electric Company of the USA
options.C: American Locomotive Company (ALCO) of the USA

e: Diesel Locomotive Works, Varanasi was set up with technical collaboration from the American Locomotive Company (ALCO) of the USA for diesel locomotive manufacture.

q: The Patiala Locomotive Works at Patiala traces its origin to the Diesel Component Works (DCW), which was set up at Patiala in the year:
e: The Diesel Component Works at Patiala, the origin of Patiala Locomotive Works, was set up in 1981 to manufacture and recondition diesel locomotive components.

q: The Railway Workshop at Jagadhari in Haryana, which undertakes overhaul of coaches and wagons, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Jagadhari Workshop in Haryana, which overhauls coaches and wagons, lies in the territory of and functions under Northern Railway.

q: The Mechanical Workshop at Izzatnagar in Bareilly, which undertakes overhaul of coaches and wagons, is a workshop of the:
e: The Mechanical Workshop at Izzatnagar, Bareilly is a North Eastern Railway workshop, Izzatnagar being the headquarters of that zone's division.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Itarsi, which homes electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Itarsi is in the Bhopal division of West Central Railway, so its Electric Loco Shed functions under West Central Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Tatanagar, which homes electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Tatanagar falls in the Chakradharpur division of South Eastern Railway, so its Electric Loco Shed belongs to South Eastern Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Andal in West Bengal, which homes electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Andal is in the Asansol division of Eastern Railway, so the Electric Loco Shed at Andal functions under Eastern Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Siliguri, which homes diesel locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Siliguri is in the Alipurduar/Katihar area of Northeast Frontier Railway, so its Diesel Loco Shed functions under that zone.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Bokaro Steel City, which homes electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Bokaro Steel City is in the Adra division of South Eastern Railway, so its Electric Loco Shed functions under South Eastern Railway.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Barauni in Bihar, which homes electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Barauni is in the Sonpur division of East Central Railway, so its Electric Loco Shed functions under East Central Railway.

q: Ghum, the highest railway station in India, is a station on the:
e: Ghum, at about 2,258 metres the highest station in India, is on the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway between Darjeeling and Kurseong.

q: The T-49 tunnel, the longest railway transport tunnel of India with a length of about 12.75 km, forms part of which railway project?
e: Tunnel T-49, about 12.75 km long between Sumber and Arpinchala, is part of the Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link project in Jammu and Kashmir.

q: In railway project execution through companies such as NHSRCL and DFCCIL, 'SPV' stands for:
e: SPV expands to Special Purpose Vehicle, a separate company created for a specific project, as used for dedicated freight corridors and bullet train work.

q: In the implementation of metro rail and station redevelopment projects, 'PPP' stands for:
e: PPP expands to Public Private Partnership, the mode in which public projects are built or operated with private investment and participation.

q: In digital payments, including payments for railway tickets, 'UPI' stands for:
e: UPI expands to Unified Payments Interface, the NPCI system for instant inter-bank transfers widely used for ticket and other digital payments.

q: In the mapping of railway assets and land plans, 'GIS' stands for:
e: GIS expands to Geographic Information System, the computer system used to map, analyse and manage geographically referenced railway assets and land.

q: In the financial justification and appraisal of railway projects, 'NPV' stands for:
e: NPV expands to Net Present Value, the present value of a project's future net cash flows, used in financial appraisal of railway projects.

q: In the financial justification and appraisal of railway projects, 'IRR' stands for:
e: IRR expands to Internal Rate of Return, the discount rate at which a project's net present value becomes zero, used to judge its financial viability.

q: In the name 'NITI Aayog', the word 'NITI' stands for:

options.D: National Institution for Technology of India

e: NITI stands for National Institution for Transforming India; NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015 as the Government's policy think tank.

q: In income tax administration, 'PAN', the number allotted to every assessee, stands for:
e: PAN expands to Permanent Account Number, the ten-character alphanumeric identifier allotted by the Income Tax Department to every assessee.

q: In banking and financial services, 'KYC', the norms for verifying the identity of customers, stands for:
e: KYC expands to Know Your Customer, the norms requiring banks and financial institutions to verify a customer's identity before providing services.

q: In the Real-time Train Information System fitted on locomotives of Indian Railways, 'GPS' stands for:
e: GPS expands to Global Positioning System, the satellite navigation system used by RTIS equipment on locomotives to report train position in real time.

q: In Indian Railways, 'DFCCIL', the company executing the dedicated freight corridors, stands for:

options.A: Dedicated Freight Company of India Limited
options.B: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited
options.C: Delhi Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited
options.D: Dedicated Freight Corridor Company of India Limited

e: DFCCIL expands to Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited, the company building the eastern and western dedicated freight corridors.

q: The diesel locomotives built at the Marhowrah factory in Bihar were exported for the first time in 2025 to which country?
e: Diesel locomotives built at the Marhowrah plant in Bihar were exported for the first time in 2025 to Guinea in West Africa.

q: The Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat (RRTS) corridor was fully opened in February 2026 with the extension of services up to which terminal station at the Meerut end?
e: The Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat RRTS corridor was fully opened in February 2026 with services extended to Modipuram, the terminal station at the Meerut end.

q: The Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) Policy of Indian Railways, under which private cargo terminals are developed, was launched in the year:
e: Indian Railways launched the Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal Policy in 2021 to promote private development of cargo terminals on railway and private land.

q: Under 'Mission 3000 MT' of Indian Railways, the target of achieving a freight loading of 3,000 million tonnes was set for the year:
e: Under Mission 3000 MT, Indian Railways set the target of 3,000 million tonnes of freight loading by the year 2027.

q: Who became the first woman to hold the post of Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Railway Board, on taking charge in September 2023?
e: Jaya Verma Sinha took charge in September 2023 as the first woman Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Railway Board.

q: Which railway station became, in 2017, the first station in India to be managed entirely by women staff?
e: Matunga station in Mumbai became in 2017 the first station in India to be managed entirely by women staff, from station manager to support staff.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of the North-Eastern region, flagged off in May 2023, runs between Kamakhya and:
e: The North-East region's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in May 2023, runs between Kamakhya (Guwahati) and New Jalpaiguri.

q: The first stretch of the Hyderabad Metro, opened for public service in November 2017, was run between Miyapur and:
e: Hyderabad Metro's first stretch, opened in November 2017, ran from Miyapur to Nagole, covering the initial section of the corridor via Ameerpet.

q: The first locomotive run in India, made in 1851 for carrying construction material for the Solani aqueduct, was run between Roorkee and:
e: India's first locomotive run in 1851 hauled construction material for the Solani aqueduct between Roorkee and Piran Kaliyar.

q: The first 'Green Corridor' section of Indian Railways, inaugurated in July 2016 as a section with zero discharge of human waste on the tracks, was the section between:
e: The Manamadurai-Rameswaram section, inaugurated in July 2016, was the first Green Corridor with bio-toilets and zero discharge of human waste on tracks.

q: After the exit of the private concessionaire in 2013, the operations of the Delhi Airport Express Line were taken over by the:

options.A: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation

e: After the private concessionaire exited in 2013, the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation took over operations of the Delhi Airport Express Line.

q: The apex body for the promotion and organisation of sports in Indian Railways is the:
e: The Railway Sports Promotion Board is the apex body that promotes, organises and controls sports activities in Indian Railways.

q: The statutory audit of Indian Railways is carried out on behalf of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India by the railway audit organisation headed by the:
e: Railway audit on behalf of the CAG is headed by the Director General of Audit, Railways, who directs the statutory audit of railway accounts.

q: All the three priority RRTS corridors being implemented by the National Capital Region Transport Corporation are planned to converge and interchange at which station in Delhi?
e: The three priority RRTS corridors from Delhi to Ghaziabad-Meerut, Panipat and Alwar are all planned to converge and interchange at Sarai Kale Khan.

q: The campus of the Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO) at Lucknow is located in the locality known as:
e: The RDSO campus at Lucknow is situated at Manak Nagar, where its directorates, laboratories and test facilities are located.

q: The Indian Railways Institute of Financial Management (IRIFM) at Secunderabad is situated at:
e: The Indian Railways Institute of Financial Management at Secunderabad, which trains accounts officers, is situated at Moula Ali.

q: 'Project Saksham' of Indian Railways was a time-bound mass drive aimed at:

options.D: Imparting training to every railway employee

e: Project Saksham was a concentrated, time-bound drive under which training was imparted to every railway employee to upgrade skills across all departments.

q: Before the restructuring of the Railway Board in 2020, the finance function in the Railway Board was headed by the officer designated as the:
e: Before the 2020 restructuring created Member (Finance), the Railway Board's finance function was headed by the Financial Commissioner (Railways).

q: The Detailed Project Report on the basis of which the Delhi Metro was planned and built was prepared by:
e: RITES Limited prepared the Detailed Project Report on the basis of which the Delhi Metro network was planned and its first phases built.

q: The Operation Control Centre (OCC) of the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor of DFCCIL is located at:
e: The Operation Control Centre of DFCCIL's Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor is located at Prayagraj, from where corridor train operations are monitored.

q: For the planning and monitoring of infrastructure projects under the PM Gati Shakti framework, the Railway Board set up in 2022 a dedicated directorate named the:
e: The Railway Board created a dedicated Gati Shakti Directorate in 2022 for planning and monitoring infrastructure projects under the PM Gati Shakti framework.

q: The special cell set up in the Railway Board to work on reform and transformation initiatives of Indian Railways is known as the:
e: The Transformation Cell was set up in the Railway Board as a special cell to drive reform and transformation initiatives across Indian Railways.

q: The 'Shri Ramayana Yatra' theme-based special tourist train, which takes pilgrims to places associated with the life of Lord Rama, is operated by the:

options.A: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation

e: IRCTC operates the Shri Ramayana Yatra and other Bharat Gaurav theme-based tourist trains taking pilgrims to places linked with Lord Rama.

q: The headquarters office of the South Eastern Railway at Kolkata is located at:
e: Garden Reach in Kolkata houses the headquarters office of South Eastern Railway, whose administrative complex is located there.

q: Ghum, the highest railway station in India, served by the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, is located in the State of:
e: Ghum is in the Darjeeling district of West Bengal, on the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway route to Darjeeling town.

q: Which station at Chennai, opened in 1856, is regarded as the oldest surviving operational railway station in India?
e: Royapuram in Chennai, opened in 1856, is regarded as the oldest surviving operational railway station in India, though now a small suburban stop.

q: India's first railway journey of 1853 commenced from which station in Bombay?
e: The first railway journey in India in 1853 started from Bori Bunder in Bombay and ran to Thane, covering 34 km.

q: The heritage steam locomotive shed at Rewari, the only surviving steam loco shed in India, is located in the State of:
e: Rewari, home to India's only surviving heritage steam loco shed, is a town in the State of Haryana.

q: The headquarters office of the Southern Railway is located at which locality of Chennai?
e: The headquarters of Southern Railway is located at Park Town in Chennai, near Chennai Central station.

q: Which Mumbai suburban station is the only station where both the Central Railway and the Western Railway suburban services halt and interchange?
e: Dadar is the only Mumbai suburban station where both Central Railway and Western Railway suburban services halt, allowing interchange between the two networks.

q: Mathura Junction, the major junction station of Uttar Pradesh, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Mathura Junction lies in the Agra division of North Central Railway, so it functions under that zone headquartered at Prayagraj.

q: The Sri Krishna Setu at Munger in Bihar, a rail-cum-road bridge opened for rail traffic in 2016, is built across the river:
e: The Sri Krishna Setu at Munger is a rail-cum-road bridge across the river Ganga, opened for rail traffic in 2016.

q: The Jhansi railway station of Uttar Pradesh was renamed in 2021 as:
e: Jhansi station was renamed in 2021 as Veerangana Laxmibai Railway Station, honouring Rani Laxmibai of Jhansi.

q: The Faizabad railway station of Uttar Pradesh was renamed in 2021 as:
e: Faizabad station was renamed in 2021 as Ayodhya Cantt, following the renaming associated with the Ayodhya region.

q: 'IRAS', the organised Group 'A' service to which the officers of the railway accounts department belong, stands for:
e: IRAS expands to Indian Railway Accounts Service, the organised Group A service of officers of the railways' accounts and finance department.

q: 'IRSS', the organised Group 'A' service of the stores department of Indian Railways, stands for:
e: IRSS expands to Indian Railway Stores Service, the organised Group A service of officers of the railways' stores and materials management department.

q: At a zonal railway headquarters, the designation 'PFA', borne by a senior officer of the accounts department, stands for:
e: PFA expands to Principal Financial Adviser, the senior-most accounts officer at a zonal railway headquarters, heading its finance and accounts organisation.

q: In a railway division, the designation 'Sr.DFM', borne by the senior-most officer of the accounts department, stands for:
e: Sr.DFM expands to Senior Divisional Finance Manager, the senior-most accounts officer in a railway division.

q: At a zonal railway headquarters, the designation 'PCSTE', borne by the head of the signal and telecommunication department, stands for:

options.A: Principal Chief Signal and Telecommunication Engineer
options.B: Principal Chief Safety and Telecom Engineer
options.C: Principal Chief Signalling and Train Engineer
options.D: Principal Chief Systems and Telecom Engineer

e: PCSTE expands to Principal Chief Signal and Telecommunication Engineer, the head of the signal and telecommunication department at zonal headquarters.

q: In Indian Railways, the computerised system 'CMS', used for booking and management of train crews such as loco pilots and guards, stands for:
e: CMS expands to Crew Management System, the computerised system used for booking, rostering and managing train crews like loco pilots and guards.

q: In Indian Railways, the computer application 'PMS', used for the booking and management of parcel traffic, stands for:
e: PMS expands to Parcel Management System, the application used for booking, loading and delivery management of parcel traffic.

q: In the Freight Operations Information System (FOIS) of Indian Railways, the sub-system 'RMS' stands for:
e: In FOIS, RMS expands to Rake Management System, the sub-system that handles indenting, allotment, placement and movement of freight rakes.

q: In the Freight Operations Information System (FOIS) of Indian Railways, the sub-system 'TMS' stands for:
e: In FOIS, TMS expands to Terminal Management System, the sub-system covering terminal activities such as goods shed working and rake handling.

q: In Indian Railways, the designation 'CAO (C)', borne by the head of a construction organisation, stands for:
e: CAO (C) expands to Chief Administrative Officer (Construction), the head of a zonal railway's construction organisation.

q: In the pay structure of the organised services, the grade denoted by 'NFSG' stands for:
e: NFSG expands to Non-Functional Selection Grade, a higher pay grade granted to organised service officers on a non-functional basis after prescribed service.

q: The Kosi Rail Mahasetu, dedicated to the nation in September 2020, is located in which district of Bihar?
e: The Kosi Rail Mahasetu, dedicated in September 2020, lies in Supaul district of Bihar, restoring the rail link across the Kosi river after decades.

q: The 351 km long first section of the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor, dedicated to the nation in December 2020, connects New Bhaupur with:
e: The 351 km Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor section dedicated in December 2020 runs between New Bhaupur and New Khurja in Uttar Pradesh.

q: Train services to the pilgrim town of Katra commenced in July 2014 with the inauguration of the rail section between Udhampur and:
e: Rail services to Katra began in July 2014 with the opening of the Udhampur to Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra section.

q: Meghalaya's first train service, flagged off in November 2014, ran from Mendipathar to:
e: Meghalaya's first train service, flagged off in November 2014, ran between Mendipathar and Guwahati in Assam.

q: Which railway station became the first in India to receive the 5-star 'Eat Right Station' certification of the FSSAI in 2021?
e: Chandigarh station became in 2021 the first station in India to receive FSSAI's 5-star Eat Right Station certification for safe and hygienic food.

q: Which railway station became the first fully solar-powered railway station in the North-Eastern Region in 2018?
e: Guwahati station became in 2018 the first fully solar-powered railway station in the North-Eastern Region, meeting its energy needs from rooftop panels.

q: The first section of the Hyderabad Metro, inaugurated in November 2017, was opened between Nagole and:
e: The first section of Hyderabad Metro, inaugurated in November 2017, was opened between Nagole and Miyapur via Ameerpet.

q: The first section of the Kochi Metro, opened for public service in June 2017, ran between Aluva and:
e: Kochi Metro's first section, opened in June 2017, ran between Aluva and Palarivattom, the initial stretch of its first corridor.

q: Arunachal Pradesh came on the railway map in 2014 with the opening of the Harmuti-Naharlagun section. Harmuti, the junction from which the section branches off, is located in the State of:
e: Harmuti, the junction for the Harmuti-Naharlagun section that brought Arunachal Pradesh on the rail map in 2014, is located in Assam.

q: India's first 'Green Train Corridor', on which trains were provided with bio-toilets so that no waste is discharged on the track, was inaugurated in July 2016 in Tamil Nadu between Rameswaram and:
e: India's first Green Train Corridor, with bio-toilets and no waste discharge on track, was inaugurated in July 2016 between Rameswaram and Manamadurai.

q: The Permanent Negotiating Machinery (PNM) of Indian Railways provides a formal forum for resolving staff matters through discussions between the Railway Administration and the:
e: Under the Permanent Negotiating Machinery, the Railway Administration formally discusses staff matters with the recognised federations of railway employees.

q: The construction of metro railway projects in metropolitan cities in India was first provided for by the:

options.D: Delhi Metro Railway (Operation and Maintenance) Act, 2002

e: Metro railway construction in metropolitan cities was first provided for by the Metro Railways (Construction of Works) Act, 1978.

q: The operation and maintenance of the Delhi Metro is governed by the:

options.C: Delhi Metro Railway (Operation and Maintenance) Act, 2002

e: The operation and maintenance of the Delhi Metro is governed by its own statute, the Delhi Metro Railway (Operation and Maintenance) Act, 2002.

q: Before the enactment of the Railway Protection Force Act, 1957, the protection of railway property was the responsibility of the railway staff organisation known as the:
e: Before the RPF Act, 1957 created a statutory force, railway property was protected by the railways' own Watch and Ward organisation.

q: Bengaluru Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL), which executes the Namma Metro project, is a joint venture of the:

options.A: Government of India and Government of Andhra Pradesh
options.B: Government of Karnataka and Bengaluru Development Authority
options.C: Ministry of Railways and Government of Karnataka
options.D: Government of India and Government of Karnataka

e: BMRCL, executing Bengaluru's Namma Metro, is a joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Karnataka.

q: Kolkata Metro Rail Corporation Limited (KMRCL) was incorporated as a joint venture of the:

options.A: Government of India and Government of West Bengal
options.B: Eastern Railway and Government of West Bengal
options.C: Government of India and Government of Odisha
options.D: Metro Railway, Kolkata and Government of West Bengal

e: KMRCL was incorporated as a joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of West Bengal for the East-West Metro project.

q: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited (IRFC) was listed on the stock exchanges of India following its initial public offer in the year:
e: IRFC was listed on the stock exchanges in 2021 following its initial public offer, which opened in January that year.

q: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited (IRCTC) made its stock market debut through an initial public offer in the year:
e: IRCTC made its stock market debut through its initial public offer in 2019, after which it was listed on the stock exchanges.

q: The first Railway Convention Committee of Parliament, which reviews the rate of dividend payable by the Railways to General Revenues, was constituted in the year:
e: The first Railway Convention Committee, which reviews the dividend payable by the Railways to General Revenues, was constituted in 1949.

q: CORAS, the commando unit of the Railway Protection Force for railway security, was formally launched in the year:
e: CORAS, the commando force of the Railway Protection Force raised for railway security and anti-terror response, was formally launched in 2019.
